acceptance: Useful server endpoint and capability metadata parse and merge safely.
evidence: Implemented server.met parsing for current headers, IPv4 endpoints, dynip host fallback, names, descriptions, user/file metadata, UDP flags, LowID users, UDP key, and TCP/UDP obfuscation ports. Merge keeps existing useful metadata when incoming rows omit a field.

acceptance: Usable Kad contacts parse and obsolete contacts are filtered.
evidence: Implemented count-first, versioned, and bootstrap-edition nodes.dat parsing. Tests cover usable contact retention, zero endpoint filtering, UDP port 53 filtering for old versions, Kad1 pruning, verified-state fallback, and truncated input rejection.
notes: No Kad1 or unusable port preservation.

evidence: Added versioned native ED2K server and Kad bootstrap rows with redb store methods. Focused persistence test covers profile-keyed server and Kad bootstrap row roundtrip.
